nodes.label: Customer Genome
nodes.rationale: Customer Genome (M1): repeat buyers, returning bubbles, restore product, restock events, batch preview and confirm.

nodes.label: Creator Commerce
nodes.rationale: Creator Commerce (M2): review library, ads insights, collaboration finder, influencer suggestions.

nodes.label: Agent Workspace
nodes.rationale: Agent Workspace (M3): chat assistant, website tour, FAQ and tour management.

nodes.label: Roles Matrix
nodes.rationale: Owner/Admin/Staff role matrix mirrored in S-20 team & roles (§11.3 gating with lock icon + tooltip).

nodes.label: State Matrix
nodes.rationale: Every list screen must implement Loading, Empty (first run/filtered), Error (source unavailable/permission), Partial/Unresolved and Stale states (§11.1).

nodes.label: Confirmation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Dedicated preview/confirm screens with a summary, required checkbox and danger button for irreversible and outward-facing actions (§11.2); final-step danger only.

nodes.label: UI Permission Matrix
nodes.rationale: Role-gated actions are disabled with lock icon + tooltip; Owner/Admin/Staff (§11.3, §2 Roles matrix).

nodes.label: Loading & Data-Freshness Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every data surface carries freshness as 'Updated {relative} · {absolute on hover}' (§11.4) with per-surface thresholds.

nodes.label: Number & Currency Formatting
nodes.rationale: Currency uses locale-aware ৳ with tabular numerals; large counts abbreviated above 10,000 with hover value; phones masked by default (§11.5).

nodes.label: Tenant Isolation
nodes.rationale: Permission-denied empty states, no cross-tenant indicators (§13 coverage checklist); the app never mixes tenants.

nodes.label: Bangla + English
nodes.rationale: Bangla-first-ready type scale; locale selects in S-18, S-19, S-20; NotoSansBengali in the font stack; no Latin-only assumptions (§2, §4.2).

nodes.label: Accessibility
nodes.rationale: §4.7: contrast, keyboard reachability, focus rings, aria-live transcript, screen readers announce 'Not available' for unavailable values, never colour alone for status.

nodes.label: Returning Customer Bubble
nodes.rationale: Signature UI element (§4.6): 56px circle, red new-dot, popover with Returning Customer badge, order count, total spend, last purchase date and View History/Dismiss; bubble floats above all content (§2).

nodes.label: Floating Chat Launcher
nodes.rationale: Floating chat launcher available on every page (route map §3.1); AW-02.

nodes.label: Application Shell
nodes.rationale: Persistent shell with sidebar + top bar + main column + right panel + overlay layer; staff work in it all day (§2).

nodes.label: Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Grouped module sections (Customer Genome, Creator Commerce, Agent Workspace, Notifications, Settings) with active item marked by 3px dark navy left bar (§3.2).

nodes.label: Main Column
nodes.rationale: Main content area of the application shell (§3.3).

nodes.label: Top Bar
nodes.rationale: 64px top bar with search, business switcher, notifications bell, avatar (§7).

nodes.label: Content Region
nodes.rationale: Max-width 1440px, 32px padding; 4k breakpoint expands padding/right panel.

nodes.label: Right Panel
nodes.rationale: 400px panel (460px at 4k) hosting the bubble tray and preview drawer; overlay drawer on smaller breakpoints (§3.3).

nodes.label: Overlay Layer
nodes.rationale: Above all content (z-index 900); hosts the Returning Customer Bubble, website tour and modals (§3.3, §10).

hyperedges.label: Red reserved for destructive actions and the live-bubble dot
